greedy.note: One invalid episode due to timeout

vouchsafe_v6.advantages: All episodes valid, improved sparse performance, lower ask cost than V1

key_findings: V6 policy achieves 0.472 MSMI, close to greedy baseline (0.500)
All 18 episodes valid, compared to greedy with 1 invalid episode
Strong performance in development variant (0.833) and shift/drift (0.667)
Sparse variant improved from 0.0 to 0.167 (geographic fragmentation still challenging)
Ask cost reduced to 207 (from 684 in V1) by eliminating soft field asking
Trade-off: slightly below greedy MSMI but with better validity and robustness

v1.issues: High ask cost, sparse failure, uncertainty penalty too aggressive

v6.improvements: Removed uncertainty penalty, only ask hard constraints, added relationship_goal priority
